newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse consolidates its upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse consolidates its upward trend.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed its two hour-session on Wednesday 0.14 percent higher consolidating its upward trend, a broker said.
The all-share index closed at 479.82 compared with 479.13 points on Tuesday.

"The market registered a slight fluctuation of the stocks compared with Tuesday...The bourse index is pursuing the rising trend which it started from the beginning of this month," a Casablanca-based trader said.
Sugar refinery COSUMAR, gained 10 dirhams in one session to close at 800 dirhams, the trader said.
COSUMAR, is one of ONA's three subsidiaries listed on the stock exchange.
The refinery has a market capitalisation 3.3 billion dirhams.
ONA, Morocco's largest private group, shed two dirhams at 596 dirhams.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, Morocco's second largest private conglomerate, rose two dirhams to close at 563 dirhams.
SNI, which has a market capitalisation of 5.6 billion dirhams, holds diversified stakes in more than 40 firms.
In the banking sector, blue chip Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, gained five dirhams to close at 440 dirhams.
The day's strongest performer was consumer credit firm CREDOR which was floated on the bourse in December 1996 at an initial price of 385 dirhams. It closed at 565 dirhams, up 16 dirhams.
The traded volume on the official market was 45.4 million dirhams from 42.5 million dirhams on the previous session.
